git-log.title: M0 — git log
git-log.success: Valid log. Git is saving snapshots. You may advance.
git-log.fail_hint: Empty or fatal = you're not in the repo or there are no commits. Run `git status` and `git log --oneline -5` in ~/Proyectos/k8s-for-stupids.

docker-mounts.title: M1 — docker inspect mounts
docker-mounts.success: Mounts detected. You know where the data lives.
docker-mounts.fail_hint: No such object = wrong name. Use `docker ps -a --format '{{.Names}}'` and copy the exact name.

k3s-nodes.title: M3 — kubectl get nodes
k3s-nodes.fail_hint: Connection refused = bad KUBECONFIG or k3s down. `sudo systemctl status k3s` and `export KUBECONFIG=/etc/rancher/k3s/k3s.yaml`.

k8s-pods.title: M4 — kubectl get pods
k8s-pods.success: Pod Running. If it says Pending/CrashLoop paste the describe too.
k8s-pods.fail_hint: CrashLoop = `logs --previous`. ImagePull = wrong name/tag or GHCR without login. Pending = CPU/RAM or PVC.

freshrss-pods.title: M6 — freshrss Running + curl
freshrss-pods.prompt: Paste `kubectl -n freshrss get pods` and `curl -f http://localhost:8080/i/`
freshrss-pods.success: FreshRSS alive. Delete the pod and verify it comes back alone.
freshrss-pods.fail_hint: If curl gives 404 use /i/ not /. If Permission denied check runAsUser/fsGroup 33 vs 1000.

saaquiz-health.title: M7 — saa-quiz /api/health
saaquiz-health.prompt: Paste `curl -f http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/health` and `kubectl -n saa-quiz get pods`
saaquiz-health.success: API alive. Now log in with the Secret's ADMIN_PASSWORD.
saaquiz-health.fail_hint: Read-only /tmp = missing emptyDir. 401 = JWT_SECRET_KEY changed, re-login or restore full /app/data.
